temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn observes that Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days during a busy, stressful week at the bank. When Carolyn asks if everything is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed Marilyn was normally engaging and not typically withdrawn, and she had no specific knowledge of what might be troubling Marilyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Marilyn's quietness is not just a passing mood; Marilyn confirms she is struggling with both work and personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is dealing with significant work and personal stress and appreciates Carolyn's concern, though she has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and supportive, with some caution about pushing too hard.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and listen if Marilyn wants to talk, without overstepping.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn had responded curtly in a later interaction, leaving Carolyn confused and slightly hurt. When Carolyn apologizes for possibly overstepping and shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed Marilyn might be upset with her or that Carolyn's earlier check-in may have overstepped, even though she knew Marilyn was overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's curtness was not personal; it came from her difficult week, and she welcomes Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The misunderstanding is cleared. Marilyn is not upset with Carolyn and values Carolyn's attempt to connect and support her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and slightly hurt; afterward relieved and reassured, with continued empathy for Marilyn.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear misunderstandings, show support, and maintain a supportive connection with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness and accepted Carolyn's invitation to a small weekend gathering, saying it sounds lovely and that she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed the misunderstanding was cleared and felt relieved and hopeful about a budding friendship with Marilyn.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn's acceptance shows she is willing to engage socially and strengthen the bond beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The friendship is developing positively; Marilyn wants to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship by hosting the gathering and building a closer social connection.

temporal_state_chain.observed: At the bank, Carolyn perceives that Marilyn is still maintaining a professional distance despite their friendly interactions outside work. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed their growing friendship might carry into a closer working relationship, but she perceives Marilyn remains professionally distant at work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn was unaware of the perceived distance and is open to discussing and improving their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The distance may be unintentional and resolvable; Marilyn is willing to improve collaboration, though Carolyn may still feel cautious.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed initially; then cautiously reassured and somewhat optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To directly address the work dynamic, improve collaboration, and bridge the perceived distance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. Marilyn agrees to team up on the new project, says she is glad they had that talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed they had cleared the air and better understood each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she felt content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Marilyn confirms the improved understanding and expresses enthusiasm for closer collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their partnership is stronger and more aligned; working together on the new project is mutually welcomed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
